Okay compared to the overated YouTube recommendation
Feb 2020
I watched a YouTube food review. The presenters loved this place. I had high expectations. In Da Nang, my partner and I entered these premises in Feb 2020. We ordered: a plate of vegan spring rolls, two banh mis, phos, and one mixed chicken salad. The tofu & pork Banh mis did not have many ingredients in them. The mock fish and beef soups were okay. We tried the fermented tofu. It did give the soup some flavor. While the food had some taste, it was not delicious. It needed more seasoning and flavor for me. I have tasted better. More improvements are needed here. The decor looked tired. My seat was uncomfortable. I hated the mock chicken mixed salad. It was chewy, bland, dry, terrible, and hard to eat. I will not be coming back again.

Fabulous food, great service
Mar 2020 • Couples
Visited here as a couple during a short stay in Danang and we were so glad we came here.
The service was excellent and done with a smile. We were welcomed with a free tea and water.
We ordered the BBQ Rice dish and the Fried Yellow Noodles dish (both 30,000 each) and we also ordered spring rolls (25,000 each), orange juice (25,000) and an iced tea (20,000). The total cost of the meal was therefore 155,000 which was so cheap considering the amount of food we got.
The food was delicious, very tasty and the waiter even brought us a soup to share also.
There is free WiFi if necessary.
Overall would absolutely recommend coming here for a cheap delicious meal!
